title: Better Bundle Progress
description: A resource pack that gives you a more precise view of how full your bundles are!
body:
This is a resource pack that allows you to better see exactly how full your bundles are! Each colour represents eight items' worth in the bundle, and individual items will slowly fill in each square.

![An image showcasing the appearance of the progress bar when a bundle has 32 items inside.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db6ce5542048509d2237d586970f8cb93dfc67ec.png) ![An image showcasing the appearance of the progress bar when a bundle has 44 items inside.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63df73c7d94b2bf4f5d2b9a9370243a8390c91fd.png) ![An image showcasing the appearance of the progress bar when a bundle has 63 items inside.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e07e0c429f5d4e5d4b70c9d5ca2f321e106d61af.png)

This is an independent project and does not require any mods or addons to work.
